title: MerlMC Modpack
description: The recommended modpack for the MerlMC Minecraft Server
body:
Although you can play MerlMC (play.merl.xyz) with a completely vanilla client, we have made a modpack full of useful mods that will enhance your experience with MerlMC.

Recommended mods already installed (Sodium, Distant Horizons, Essential, etc)
Pre-Installed Resource Packs & Shader ready to apply
Voice Chat Mod ready to go! (Click "V" in-game to set up)

Feel free to use this pack as is, or as a base to add your own mods to (if you know what you're doing) or not use it at all. Up to you!

This pack includes [Bliss Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/bliss-shader).
